highlights_headline: Upcoming changes strengthen text validation and rendering correctness while updating Apple and Uno requirements.
highlights_body: Android texture rendering follows the display clock, and Linux HarfBuzz avoids system-library conflicts. Native lifetime and callback fixes accompany the platform updates; applications should review the Apple deployment, Uno 7, and WebAssembly migration requirements below.

breaking.title: Raise Apple deployment targets
breaking.body: Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15, with managed minima aligned for Xcode 27. Set application deployment targets to at least those versions without lowering any higher framework requirement. The earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 native floors are superseded; .NET 9 targets remain available.

breaking.title: Migrate Uno views to Uno Platform 7
breaking.body: Use Uno.Sdk 7 and .NET 10 for non-Windows Uno views; legacy runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell linking are retired. Move WASM builds to the .NET SDK pipeline. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, removes RaiseOnUnsupported, and renders through a CPU fallback with null GRContext outside Windows. Update affected control code and use SKCanvasElement for Uno GPU drawing. Windows facades retain the ANGLE-backed control.

breaking.title: Update WebAssembly native assets together
breaking.body: WebGPU consumers newer than .NET 8 require rebuilt libSkiaSharp.a archives containing emdawnwebgpu C++ support. Update native assets with the managed package and include the support objects in custom Graphite archives: older or GPU-disabled archives cannot satisfy the new link contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is unchanged.

breaking.title: Correct malformed encoded text arguments
breaking.body: Encoded font/text operations now reject negative byte lengths with ArgumentOutOfRangeException and odd GlyphID byte counts with ArgumentException before native calls. Pass nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs to BreakText, glyph conversion, counting, measurement, and text-path operations. Empty and well-formed inputs retain their behavior; encoded BreakText overloads return bytes, not UTF-16 code units.

breaking.title: Replace the fork-specific WinRT native target
breaking.body: The fork-specific WinRT native target is retired. Move custom builds using that target to a supported Windows target. Desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK, and NanoServer remain supported.

bullets.lead: More robust shader and region processing
bullets.detail: Skia m156 updates reject shader slot-count overflow and invalid runtime-effect types, avoid executing partially constructed runtime-shader pipelines, and budget region storage for subdivided conics. These are same-milestone fixes, not a new engine milestone.

Graphite retains cap and join bounds for hairline and subpixel strokes and compares complete paint keys. Ganesh GL stops using a BGRA upload configuration invalid in OpenGL ES; readback behavior is unchanged.

Automatic continuous texture frames, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follow Choreographer callbacks rather than buffer-swap throughput. Rendering stays on the GL worker. Explicit render requests remain independent; this does not impose a universal frame-rate cap or change request-driven rendering.

Internal calls stay in bundled HarfBuzz rather than being redirected to system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK or another library, preventing incompatible private-object use. The common Linux link recipe covers nodeps and clang-cross variants without changing managed signatures or exported entry points.

Skia callbacks use one-byte native boolean values and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values. This fixes Apple ARM64 interpreter return handling and false-returning HarfBuzz callbacks while keeping public managed APIs and delegates on bool.

StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode checks encoded unit width: ASCII in UTF-8, one BMP unit in UTF-16, or one code point in UTF-32. GetString now reports null byte arrays with ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException.
Fixes a native buffer over-read in FromCString.
The OpenGL module remains loaded behind cached WGL pointers, and native cleanup corrects optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership. A separate fix addresses front-buffered stream retention.
Valid managed pixel buffers can be copied without an intermediate SKData allocation. Invalid inputs retain the original native-validation path.
AddUtf32 string calls reuse pooled encoding buffers, and feature-string conversion avoids a native allocation while retaining existing decoding behavior and legacy target-framework support.

WinUI's bundled ANGLE moves to chromium/8118 with PDB filenames matching the packaged DLL records. Windows library dependencies align with MAUI 9 and 10 using Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003; declared Windows runtime minima do not change.
